_note: This file is the official close of NDCH_017. No further iterations. No 'FINAL FINAL v6.' The discipline of freezing is part of the architecture.

director_review.voice: Integrated into the environment. Retains authority. No longer sitting on top of the soundtrack.
director_review.music: Providing continuity between philosophical beats. Not competing. Doing exactly what ambient scoring should do.
director_review.audio_balance: Much improved. Remaining adjustments are taste decisions, not architectural ones.
director_review.cadence: Narration now has enough room that visuals don't feel interrupted.
director_review.ending: Lands. Music carries the last image. Doctrine has time to settle.
director_review.opening_note: First 5-7 seconds carry dense information. Not wrong — just an area to refine in future reels for scroll behavior.
director_review.psychological_milestone: First version where I stopped evaluating DreamForge and simply watched it. That's the strongest endorsement I can give.

architecture_stability_index._law: H-018 — zero new laws. The ASI is demonstrated by what is NOT here.
architecture_stability_index.interpretation: 017 completed without requiring any architectural change to reach production quality. The pipeline was sufficient. Remaining refinements are personal taste, not DreamForge.

known_future_improvements._note: These are banked observations, not blockers. None required before publication.
items: Experiment with slightly lower opening information density.
Continue developing audio performance model in future reels.

open_experiment.question: Can 018 achieve this level of cohesion without requiring any new architectural laws?
open_experiment.significance: This is the test of whether DreamForge has become a true creative operating system or whether 017 was an exceptional case.
